summary: Quantifies and visualizes the temporal dynamics of cell-type and subcluster counts across developmental stages in integrated scRNA-seq datasets to assess diversification trends.
use_when: How does cell-type diversity evolve across postnatal mouse development?
Identify emerging cell-type clusters in visual cortex developmental data
Calculate the number of subclusters per developmental time point
Assess if cell-type count plateaus during visual cortex maturation
Generate temporal trajectory plots for cell-type differentiation
avoid_when: A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
